propositions: ChatGPT sessions with GitHub connector but no local Rebar tracker worktree, native rebar binary, or network access cannot create tickets natively and need a documented safe fallback

A fallback ticket payload must conform to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version, ticket_id as agent-generated UUID4, ticket_type, title, status: open) plus description and parent_id if applicable, without claiming persistence

The rebar import command is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path; it accepts NDJSON, assigns fresh local ids/HLC timestamps, silently skips records missing ticket_id/ticket_type with no counter increment in dry-run mode, and is idempotent by source_id

Guidance must define the exact capability-failure condition triggering fallback (tracker-worktree AND network/binary unavailable) and prohibit hand-authoring event files or Contents API writes to the tickets branch
Missing-ticket_id/ticket_type records are detectable in dry-run via shortfall between (would_create + skipped) and total record count, requiring rebar validate/fsck confirmation afterward
Documentation must teach environment capability checks covering local checkout, native rebar/rebar-mcp binary, tracker worktree, network/remote access, GitHub connector, and Gerrit availability
